Situation: Amikacin sulfate 250 mg/mL 4 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 149 vials with a daily use of 4.3 vials, providing 34.4 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show amikacin sulfate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 34 days. Multiple manufacturers have product available and none appear on FDA's shortage list today. No supply disruption is indicated at this time.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as primary source; buyer approves.
2. Maintain Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary source; buyer approves.
3. Keep Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as tertiary source; buyer approves.
4. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly for any status change; buyer approves.
5. Report inventory levels to P&T committee monthly; pharmacy director approves.

Not recommended: No allocation, conservation, or alternative agent protocols at this time.
